correctness.rationale: Direct characteristic polynomial of the full row generator is z[z²+2Gz+3(H+j²)], hence λ±=−G±sqrt(Δ²−3j²). An equal-eigenvalue restriction is semisimple only at g uniform and j=0; otherwise it is an exceptional point. The allowed |j|<min(g) yields sharp feasibility Δ²<3m². For stationary π_i=1/3, σ=(2j/3)Σ log[(g_i+j)/(g_i−j)]. Strict convexity of f_j(x) and Jensen give σ≥2|j|log[(G+3|j|)/(G−3|j|)] with equality only uniform g, and the latter function strictly increases to ∞, proving the attained bound and unique equality. Independently checked symbolic spectrum and 375 rational triples with three j ratios.
